units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 1:5">Targ. Gen. I, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 39:11">Ib. XXXIX, 11</cite>; a. fr.—
Targ. Prov. XII, 16 בר יוֹמֵיה (ed. Wil. incorr. כד) on the same day, at once.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 39b:6">Kidd. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>דעבדין ליה י׳ טב וי׳ ביש</he> they prepare for him (the righteous man) a good day, and (for the bad man) a bad day (v. Rashi a. Tosaf. a. l.).—
<cite ref="Shabbat 134a:11">Sabb. 134ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 60a:1">Ḥull. 60ᵃ</cite> top <he>להדי י׳</he> towards the sunlight.
<cite ref="Chullin 60a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>י׳ דחד וכ׳</he> the sun which is only one of the ministering powers &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 106a:6">Keth. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>וכסי ליה לי׳</he> and obscured the sun.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 72a:3">Yeb. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>י׳ דעיבא</he> a cloudy day; <he>י׳ דשותא</he> a day when a southern wind blows.
<cite ref="Eruvin 40b:16">Erub. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>במעלי י׳ דריש וכ׳</he> on the eve of the New Year’s day.—
R. Hash. 21ᵃ י׳ רבה the Great Day, Day of Atonement (also only יומא, v. infra); a. v. fr.—בַּר י׳, בַּת י׳ of the same day, one day old, used the same day.
<cite ref="Beitzah 4b:2">Bets. 4ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00668"><he>בֵּיעָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 58b:2">Ḥull. 58ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="B01111"><he>בַּקָּא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 134a:11">Sabb. 134ᵃ</cite> <he>גבינה בת י׳</he> fresh-made cheese.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 67b:7">Ab. Zar. 67ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>קדירה בת י׳</he> a pot used the same day.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 49b:15">Sabb. 49ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ההוא מרבנן בר יוֹמֵיה</he> (omitted in Ms. M.) a student that had just come to college; [oth. opin.: allusion to R. Idi, dubbed <he>בר בי רב דחד י׳</he> the one day’s student of the college, <cite ref="Chagigah 5b:19">Ḥag. 5ᵇ</cite>].—<he>י׳ חרא</he>, <he>יום מחרא</he>, <he>י׳ מחרן</he>, v. next w.—Pl. <he>יוֹמִין</he>, <he>יוֹמַיָּא</he>, <he>יוֹמֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 8:10">Targ. Gen. VIII, 10</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 1:2">Targ. Esth. I, 2</cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Beitzah 4b:9">Bets. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>עבדינן תרי י׳</he> we observe two days (as Holy Days).

Erub. 65ᵃ השתא … י׳ דאריכי וכ׳ soon will come the days which are long (of duration) and short (of action), when we shall sleep much; a. v. fr.—יוֹמָא (sub רבה, v. supra) Yoma, name of a treatise of the Mishnah, Tosefta (where it is named יום כפורים), Talmud Babli a. Y’rushalmi.

<cite ref="Yoma 14b:5">Yoma 14ᵇ</cite> <he>סדר י׳</he> the treatise on the order of exercises of the Day of Atonement.—V. <cite ref="J00197"><he>יוֹמָנָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="J00416"><he>יְמָמָא</he></cite>.
